doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: As a user, I want to download all necessary tools from one place, so that I don't have to search for them. Companion Tools section with Q-FLASH-FORGE, WinUSB Driver, and Zadig tool cards.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Page components follow standard structure with header, main content area, and i18n integration. Use shadcn/ui components for consistent styling.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: All feature components follow structure: hooks at top, derived state, handlers, render. Use cn() for className merging.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Add Companion Tools section with Q-FLASH-FORGE (ROM processing), WinUSB Driver (QDLoader 9008), and Zadig (driver installation tool). Each card shows name, description, version, download links.

doc.title: Story 3.3: Expanded Guide Page
doc.snippet: Guide page references driver installation tools. Downloads page should provide easy access to these tools (WinUSB Driver, Zadig).

story-context.constraints: - Follow Page Component Pattern from architecture.md: header with title/description, main content area - Use shadcn/ui Card components for consistent styling across all tool cards - All text content MUST use i18n translations (downloads.* namespace) - External links MUST use target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" for security - Add data-tracking attributes for future analytics integration (data-tool, data-action) - Responsive grid layout: 1 column mobile, 2-3 columns desktop - Companion Tools section MUST appear ABOVE Stock ROMs section - Maintain Linear Violet theme colors for consistency - Badge component may need installation: npx shadcn@latest add badge - DO NOT modify core logic files (src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/)

interface.name: ToolCardProps

tests.standards: Testing standards for Q-Flash-Web follow Vitest + React Testing Library patterns. Component tests should verify rendering, user interactions, and i18n integration. For this story, focus on: (1) DownloadsPage renders Companion Tools section above Stock ROMs, (2) All 3 tool cards render with correct content, (3) Links have correct attributes (target, rel, data-tracking), (4) i18n translations work for both EN and VI.
tests.ideas: - AC1: Test DownloadsPage renders "Companion Tools" section before "Stock ROMs" section - AC2: Test Q-FLASH-FORGE card renders with GitHub link and correct tracking ID - AC3: Test WinUSB Driver card renders with download link - AC4: Test Zadig card renders with download link - AC5: Test each ToolCard shows name, description, version badge, and button - AC6: Test tracking attributes (data-tool, data-action) are present on cards and buttons - AC7: Test all external links have target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" - AC8: Test i18n - switch language and verify all content translates - Integration: Test responsive grid layout on different viewport sizes - Integration: Test hover effects on cards and buttons
